decision.question: Which base reading should the provisional translation follow?
decision.resolution: Retain the 1906 printed opening, order and section numbers, with a source-status note; keep parallel wording in commentary; authorial finality unresolved. Does not approve English fidelity or the pending workflow.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D002; English review pending. Model judgments are evidence, not approval.
decision.question: Welttheil; Sprachkunde
decision.resolution: continent; study of language. Readable geographical/disciplinary expressions; America remains the single unit used in this passage, not a modern two-continent classification. Alternatives: part of the world; linguistic scholarship

decision.authority: Coordinator under D002; English review pending. Model judgments are evidence, not approval.
decision.question: zusammengeflossen; bedeutendsten; Sprachstämme; Bildung
decision.resolution: converged; very considerable; language stocks; development. Convergence does not assert mixing; absolute/elative superlative does not require a formal ranking. The grammar makes the stocks and attained Bildung linguistic. No modern genealogical rank or universal Bildung equivalent is asserted. Alternatives: flowed together; the most significant differences; language families; cultivation

decision.authority: Coordinator under D002; English review pending. Model judgments are evidence, not approval.
decision.question: Nationaleigenthümlichkeit; Eigenthümlichkeiten; Einwanderungen
decision.resolution: national distinctiveness; distinctive traits; immigration (mass noun). Related distinctive vocabulary preserves the conceptual connection; retain national without equating it with a nation-state. Mass immigration covers the plural events and supplies the repeated elliptical noun. Alternatives: national individuality / individualities; inner national character; immigrations

decision.authority: Coordinator under D002; English review pending. Model judgments are evidence, not approval.
decision.question: nur durch sich selbst; in Gährung ihrer Kräfte gerathen
decision.resolution: solely from within / through themselves alone; came into a ferment of their powers. Remove added activity noun and causative passive. Keep the peoples as the subject entering the state. Different English phrasing expresses the repeated self-relation without imposing one awkward formula. Alternatives: only through themselves in both clauses; their powers were set fermenting solely from within

decision.authority: Coordinator under D002; English review pending. Model judgments are evidence, not approval.
decision.question: solange ... kennen; bis auf ... Unterjochung; frei von fremdem Einfluss
decision.resolution: known historical interval; down to subjugation by Europeans; freedom as an adjunct. Temporal reading of bis auf is retained alongside the knowledge limit. The exceptive reading remains possible. Keep the freedom phrase within the entry-into-ferment clause; the second predicate follows in a new English sentence without adding a new temporal bridge. Alternatives: except for European subjugation

decision.authority: Coordinator under D002; English review pending. Model judgments are evidence, not approval.
decision.question: abschleifend; einheimischer Verkehr; Fremdes
decision.resolution: wearing-down; self-contained native interaction; anything foreign. Retain abrasion rather than making equalisation the asserted outcome. Interaction differs from contact in s5; native contrasts with foreign. The reflexive stays with the interaction, not an inserted continent noun. Self-contained is understood here at the passage’s collective level, not as isolation of each community. Anything foreign avoids narrowing to discrete linguistic elements. Alternatives: levelling; smoothing; native intercourse confined to itself; whatever foreign matter

decision.authority: Brett: saved looks good comment, one Roughdraft completion event, then direct chat proceed; see approval record.
decision.question: §1 English review and next bounded action
decision.resolution: Accept §1 English/editorial usefulness and execute one §2 comparison/audit cycle, stopping before §3. Does not certify fidelity or source finality.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D004; provisional source interpretation; English review pending.
decision.question: Dafür ... nun auch
decision.resolution: Further support for this. Keep backward reference broad; do not replace it with a claim of common descent or a uniquely identified §1 thesis. Alternatives: now also speaks in favour of this

decision.authority: Coordinator under D004; provisional source interpretation; English review pending.
decision.question: Ausbildung; in ihnen selbst; alle
decision.resolution: development; in the languages themselves; them all. Languages is a defensible discourse/context reading of ihnen, not a grammatical proof. Nations remains a possible antecedent. Keep alle pronominal; the explicit earlier choice may tilt the English reader toward languages, a limitation recorded rather than hidden. Nations renders Nationen without an implied modern nation-state. Alternatives: cultivation; in the nations themselves; unmistakable within them as well

decision.authority: Coordinator under D004; provisional source interpretation; English review pending.
decision.question: alphabetischer Schrift; eigentlicher Literatur; niedrigeren Stufe
decision.resolution: alphabetic writing; literature in the proper sense; a lower level. Preserve both lexical restrictions, the asserted hence relation, without exception and lower comparative. This is Humboldt’s evaluation; no neutral or modern historical correction is silently substituted. The parallel lacks the lower-level phrase. Alternatives: literature proper; at a lower stage

decision.authority: Coordinator under D004; provisional source interpretation; English review pending.
decision.question: Einerleiheit / Aehnlichkeit; Bau; auch wohl; wirklich
decision.resolution: sameness / similarity; structure; also been asserted; in fact. Reject alleged sameness and alleged deviation from all other languages without losing retained similarity. Wrongly modifies only the first assertion. Do not repeat a frequency adverb for the second, where wohl is not clearly temporal. Restore explicit in fact. Structure remains consistent with §1, without fixing a universal glossary. Alternatives: uniformity / resemblance; also sometimes been asserted; also possibly asserted

decision.authority: Coordinator under D004; provisional source interpretation; English review pending.
decision.question: Welttheil; erlaubt; nicht einmal darin; abscheidende Gränzen
decision.resolution: continent; do not permit ... even in this respect; genuinely separating boundaries. Retain continent from §1 and idiomatic English plural agreement. The printed singular erlaubt is preserved in the German; it does not by itself establish an intended collective conceptual contrast. Keep darin’s reference open, rather than inserting a claim of a strict north/south genealogy or national border. Alternatives: part of the world; the continent, north and south, does not permit; truly dividing boundaries

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Sprache / Sprechen be rendered?
decision.resolution: Name the bearer: human capacity, a particular inherited language, available stock/system, or an act of speaking. Keep changes of standpoint visible. Exceptions: Do not reduce all language to either a code or an individual utterance. Kawi is a separately dated comparison. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Sprachkunde / Sprachstudium be rendered?
decision.resolution: Use study of language(s) for the inquiry in §§1–3 and distinguish its object from the faculty of language. Exceptions: Use linguistics only when its modern disciplinary connotations do not supply an extra historical claim. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Typus / Sprachtypus / Urtypus be rendered?
decision.resolution: Identify what has the pattern. §16 concerns the mental process; later contexts concern construction and the grammar operative in a speaker. Exceptions: Do not default to a taxonomic language class, proto-language or one fixed modern typology. Title: retain general type provisionally, with a note explaining the process bearer. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Form / Materie / Stoff be rendered?
decision.resolution: Keep form visible and state its bearer and relational counterpart. §55 contrasts words with discourse-connection; §136 contrasts thought-form with language-form. Exceptions: Do not equate every Form with shape, morphology, syntax, inner form or a separate metaphysical substance. Later Kawi’s definition is not retroactively imposed. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Bau / Sprachbau / Construction be rendered?
decision.resolution: Structure is the default in §§1–2. Include coordinated relations of parts and their operation, rather than implying an inert anatomical object. Exceptions: Construction may concern sentence organization or a mathematical analogy; it does not name modern Construction Grammar. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Bildung / Ausbildung / Fortbildung / bildsam be rendered?
decision.resolution: Use formation for producing a word/concept/form; development for attained linguistic or national stages; cultivation when exercise and improvement of powers are salient. Preserve evaluative strength. Exceptions: Education is not the universal gloss. Separate ongoing change, attained development and claimed perfection. Bildsamkeit is capacity to be shaped. Einbildungskraft belongs to imagination. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Eigenthümlichkeit / Individualität / Charakter be rendered?
decision.resolution: Retain related vocabulary while identifying whether the bearer is a sound, word, language, people or individual speaker. §§29,49,50 successively qualify individuality. Exceptions: No invariant boundary between all three nouns is established. Do not conflate character with inner form or a fixed national essence; commentators emphasize different explanatory roles. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Geist / geistig / Verstand / Vernunft / Seele / Gemüth / Einbildungskraft be rendered?
decision.resolution: Use mind/mental for thinking agency unless the local spiritual or metaphysical emphasis requires spirit. Preserve the distinct faculty names when the source contrasts them. Exceptions: No fixed modern faculty diagram or Hegelian system is inferred. §126 itself discusses historical changes in these words’ apprehension. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Kraft / Vermögen / Fähigkeit be rendered?
decision.resolution: Keep power, capacity and activity distinct. Linguistic powers can be exercised, grow and act on inherited material. Exceptions: Do not default to physical force/energy; do not assert these neighbouring nouns are strict technical synonyms. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Thätigkeit / Wirkung / Verfahren be rendered?
decision.resolution: Separate the doing, its effect and its manner. Preserve the process/product distinction and the reciprocal influence actually claimed. Exceptions: Wirkung may be operation in context. Do not add activity to a source that names powers alone; later Energeia does not replace every early noun. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Denken / Gedanke / Begriff be rendered?
decision.resolution: Distinguish activity, thought-content and concept where the argument does so. Word and concept are mutually involved, rather than words merely labelling finished concepts. Exceptions: Do not impose Fregean Sinn/Bedeutung or treat every thought-related noun as a strict synonym. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Vorstellung / Anschauung / Auffassung be rendered?
decision.resolution: Choose by local role: representing, sensible/intuitive presentation, or taking an object in a particular way. In §98 the speaker’s apprehension corresponds to the hearer’s designation. Exceptions: Not every Anschauung is visual seeing or an opinion; not every use establishes a fixed Kantian technical sense. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Ansicht / Weltansicht be rendered?
decision.resolution: Use view/approach for grammatical ways of organizing relations. In §39 preserve the language-mediated view of the world and individual/historical variation. Exceptions: Do not automatically turn Anschauung der Welt into the headword Weltansicht, or equate Weltansicht with ideology/Weltanschauung. Underhill’s contrast is an interpretive aid, not an invariant law of Humboldt’s vocabulary. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Bezeichnung / Bedeutung / Ausdruck / Selbstbedeutung be rendered?
decision.resolution: Determine whether designation concerns a concept, thought-relation, audible marking or manner of presentation. Preserve §98’s explicitly conceptual standpoint. Exceptions: No universal denotation/signification split is established. Selbstbedeutung is motivating apprehension, not simply present dictionary meaning or verified etymology. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Zeichen / Symbol be rendered?
decision.resolution: In §101 retain both the word’s sign-like purpose and the claim that the concept is completed through it; keep symbol as a qualified comparison. Exceptions: Do not simplify to word = sign or word = symbol. Deleted notes on p428 and Kawi p46 are identified as variants, not the active assertion. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Laut / Ton / Schall / Articulation / Accent be rendered?
decision.resolution: Use local auditory and articulatory function. Distinguish quantity, organizing accent and Chinese intonation where the argument contrasts them. Exceptions: Neither Ton = pitch throughout nor Laut = a modern phoneme is justified. Historical physiological/evaluative claims remain attributed to Humboldt. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Buchstabe / Alphabet / Schrift / Buchstabenschrift / Literatur / eigentliche Literatur be rendered?
decision.resolution: Inspect the bearer: §§56–58 discuss articulated sounds and their inventory before writing’s separate role in §71. Explain a retained letter where necessary. Exceptions: Do not turn sound change into orthographic change. Preserve alphabetic in §§1–2; it is not interchangeable with all writing. In §2 preserve literature in the proper sense and the asserted consequence from missing alphabetic writing; these are Humboldt’s restrictions and judgement. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Wort / Wortlaut / Wörtervorrath / Wortvorrath be rendered?
decision.resolution: Retain sound/concept unity, actual use and the wider vocabulary network; words as dictionary objects are an analytic standpoint, not their entire existence. Exceptions: The singular/plural-compound variants in the headings do not establish separate technical systems. Do not normalize source spelling silently. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Wurzel / Stammwort / Analogie be rendered?
decision.resolution: Distinguish productive pattern, relative base and proposed historical origin. Sound resemblance alone does not establish descent. Exceptions: No compulsory derivation of every word from a root; inherited lexical material need not carry its original productive pattern with it. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Rede / Redeverbindung / Redefügung / Redensart be rendered?
decision.resolution: Use connected speech/discourse and its joining where organization and utterance are at issue. §129 starts analytically from speech as a whole. Exceptions: Do not reduce every Rede to one sentence, or every Redensart to a frozen idiom. Redeverbindung includes more than mere sound concatenation. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Satz / Periode be rendered?
decision.resolution: Preserve §136’s distinction of units: thought-relations give Satz unity, while Periode also embodies linguistic organization and intelligible utterance. Retain German on first explanation. Exceptions: The final local choice between proposition and sentence requires the full translated passage. Periode is not merely any long sentence; no one-to-one modern clause/sentence mapping is fixed here. Limit: Local distinction image-checked; English labels remain an explicitly open decision for §136.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Grammatik / Logik / allgemeine Grammatik / grammatische Ansicht be rendered?
decision.resolution: Keep conceptual thought-relations, a language’s view of them, its technical means and their sounds separate. General grammar covers only part of the general process inquiry. Exceptions: No modern innate universal grammar is imported. Missing inflection is not missing thought or all grammar. Kawi’s language-form extends beyond conventional grammar. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Hinzudenken / Andeutung / ausdrückliche Grammatik / stillschweigende Grammatik be rendered?
decision.resolution: Distinguish what speakers and hearers supply in thought from what audible language indicates. Andeutung can be fixed and strong; the boundary of genuine form is graded in §149. Exceptions: Mental supplementation need not be conscious inference or recovery of an actually deleted word. Genuine form is not simply inflection: §147 allows immutable word order in principle only with a fixed reference point identifiable independently of position. This is the local §147 test, not a universal definition across writings. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Sachbegriff / Begriffsbezeichnung / Verhältnissbezeichnung / Formalität be rendered?
decision.resolution: Preserve the distinction between content supplied as an object/concept and a relation marked as relation. Check the present function rather than etymological origin alone. For Formalität in §144 preserve the claimed awakening of form as form in the mind, beyond assistance to comprehension. Exceptions: Formalität here does not mean empty ceremony. An originally substantive word may become relational as its prior meaning is lost. Formal character remains a provisional label for that claimed effect; settle its full English expression in the local passage. Limit: Concept/relation contrast supported locally; the best English nominal rendering of Formalität remains open, with its effect specified.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Aehnlichkeit / Einerleiheit / Verwandtschaft / Abstammung / Verschiedenheit be rendered?
decision.resolution: Keep likeness, identity, historical connection and common human capacities distinct. §§1–2 claim broad similarity while rejecting uniform structure. Exceptions: Contact and shared capacities can both yield resemblance; §47 leaves empirical separation open. Do not infer a single original language or continental language family. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Volk / Nation / Stamm / Sprachstamm / Horde / Familie be rendered?
decision.resolution: Identify human versus linguistic grouping. Keep language stocks for §1 Sprachstämme and the separate human group terms in the later sentence. Exceptions: Nation does not automatically imply a modern state. Preserve historically charged/evaluative labels without converting them into present scientific classifications. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Verkehr / Berührung be rendered?
decision.resolution: In §1 use interaction for reciprocal dealings and contact for Berührung; retain the restricted native setting the source asserts. Exceptions: Do not narrow Verkehr to commerce, transport or textual correspondence, and do not add an undocumented mechanism of mixture. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Gährung / abschleifen / abschleifend be rendered?
decision.resolution: Retain the ferment-of-powers and abrasion metaphors in §1. In the ferment clause keep peoples as subject and freedom from foreign influence as an adjunct. In the abrasion sentence, previously introduced foreign material undergoes the wearing-down influence of native interaction. Exceptions: Smoothing/levelling are possible explanations, not evidence that all differences disappear. The dictionary supplies the physical range, not a settled sociolinguistic mechanism. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Welttheil be rendered?
decision.resolution: Continent is the consistent geographical equivalent in §§1–2. Keep geography distinct from a demonstrated genealogical unit. Exceptions: The printed singular erlaubt in §2 remains in German; English plural agreement does not prove an alternate German subject. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should wohl / bisweilen / bis auf / doch / zwar / nun auch be rendered?
decision.resolution: Translate the sentence relation first. In §2 bisweilen supplies sometimes; auch wohl does not warrant automatically repeating that frequency. Keep §1’s temporal bis auf provisional. Exceptions: The dictionary gives several wohl functions and temporal bis auf examples, not a unique occurrence reading. Pronoun reference and focus require local notes, not a global particle glossary. Limit: A narrower particle/focus judgement remains open; current §§1–2 choices need no change on the evidence assembled.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Treue / das Fremde / Fremdheit be rendered?
decision.resolution: Use these as explicitly attributed translation-policy controls from the 1816 introduction: character matters, arbitrary decoration is removed, and explanation is separate. Exceptions: Not certified technical headwords throughout Grundzüge; a policy for Greek tragedy is not automatically a rule to copy German syntax or impose metre. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Gefühl / Empfindung / Geltung be rendered?
decision.resolution: In §§105 and125, feeling includes an overall intellectual/affective orientation and can operate without reflective consciousness. In §§87–88 Geltung concerns sensible presence/efficacy given through sound; in §121 it concerns lexical/grammatical role. Translate by the bearer. Exceptions: Emotion and legalistic validity are not automatic defaults. These are provisional distinctions, not a non-overlapping psychological taxonomy. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should Mittel / Bestandtheile / Behandlung be rendered?
decision.resolution: Keep the devices and constituents distinct from their coordinated treatment and effect, respecting §12’s warning that the separation is not rigid. Exceptions: Do not infer that close structural detail is dispensable because process and the whole are primary. Limit: Conditional default supported by representative contexts; inspect each new occurrence before applying.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D006; provisional preparation norm, not human fidelity approval
decision.question: How should zusammenfliessen / zusammengeflossen / Mischung / Vermischung be rendered?
decision.resolution: In §1 use convergence for languages occurring together geographically unless their blending is actually asserted. In historical passages translate mixture when the source names it, keeping contact, convergence and shared descent distinct. Exceptions: The Untersuchungen parallel explicitly names mixing; do not substitute it for the base’s different wording or infer which version came first. Limit: Opening choice checked by coordinator after the register audits; no global synonymy or revised chronology is asserted.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: were free from foreign influence. Over that period,
evidence.statement: In the German both temporal qualifiers sit inside the first conjunct (sind ... gerathen), and the second conjunct (haben sich ... mitgetheilt) has its own auxiliary and no temporal adverbial. The split does two things. It promotes 'frei von fremdem Einfluss' to a free-standing main assertion that carries the qualifiers; this is defensible only if 'sind ... frei' is read as an asyndetic predicate, not as a predicative adjunct to 'gerathen'. It also adds 'Over that period', which correctly carries the qualification to the fermentation clause and makes explicit its extension to the mutual-communication clause, which the German leaves to inference. No qualification is lost and no claim is left unqualified.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: down to European subjugation
evidence.statement: 'bis auf' can be temporal ('down to') or exceptive ('except for'). The English picks the temporal reading, which pairs naturally with 'solange wir ... kennen' as start and end limits. The exceptive reading would attach to 'frei von fremdem Einfluss' and parallel 'ausser den neuesten Europäischen Einwanderungen' in g:s4. Both make the European subjugation the limit of the claim, so the practical difference is small. Separately, the definite article of 'die' is dropped.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: only through their own activity
evidence.statement: 'activity' has no German counterpart; the source says only 'through themselves'. In g:s5 the phrase covers the fortunes of peoples and languages alike, so an agentive noun narrows it. In g:s6 'were set fermenting' adds a causative passive where the German has the tribes themselves coming into ferment (sind ... gerathen). The repetition of the phrase across g:s5 and g:s6 is correctly preserved, and the restriction 'only' is intact in both.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: local contact confined to the continent itself
evidence.statement: Three shifts in one phrase. 'einheimisch' (native, indigenous) is the counter-term to 'Fremdes' in the same sentence, and 'local' weakens that contrast and can suggest small-scale locality. 'auf sich selbst' is reflexive to 'Verkehr' (intercourse confined to itself), and the English substitutes 'the continent', a referent the phrase does not name. 'Verkehr' is rendered with the same word as 'Berührung' in g:s5, collapsing a lexical distinction. The overall internal-versus-external sense is still conveyed, so this is not a reversal.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: this levelling influence
evidence.statement: 'abschleifen' is to grind or wear down, to abrade. 'levelling' is an interpretive step towards homogenisation, which anticipates the similarity argument of §2 rather than the image in §1. The demonstrative 'diesen' is correctly kept and points back to the process in g:s6.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: such diverse languages have mingled
evidence.statement: 'zusammengeflossen' is confluence: languages have flowed together into these parts of the world. 'mingled' can be read as mixture of the languages themselves, which is the sense of 'vermischt' in the parallel fragment that the packet says not to import. The base text asserts co-presence within one continent, as the following 'Verbindung ... innerhalb der Gränzen desselben Welttheils' confirms.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: very considerable differences
evidence.statement: The German superlative, even read as an absolute superlative, is stronger than 'very considerable'. The English slightly understates the author's evaluation of the differences in structure and attained 'Bildung'.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: only through their own activity
evidence.statement: German has only the reflexive pronoun phrase through themselves and no noun for activity. Adding activity turns self-mediation in sich gestaltet and gerathen into a specified causal agency, and in g:s5 attributes activity jointly to peoples and languages. This imports a concept not lexicalised here.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: were free from foreign influence. Over that period, their powers were set fermenting only through their own activity
evidence.statement: sind is the sein-auxiliary of gerathen, with the plural-construed Menge of tribes as subject, and frei von fremdem Einfluss is an adjunct inside that predicate. English promotes freedom to an independent copular claim and recasts intransitive ingressive gerathen as a passive causative whose subject is their powers, shifting who enters the state and implying a setter.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: this levelling influence
evidence.statement: abschleifend denotes wearing, grinding or smoothing away by abrasion. Levelling is a plausible inferred homogenising effect, but it specifies equalisation as the outcome and moves focus from the abrasion undergone by whatever foreign matter was introduced. It is an interpretive narrowing rather than a demonstrable mistranslation.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: local contact confined to the continent itself
evidence.statement: No continent noun occurs in g:s7. The participle phrase modifies Verkehrs, so sich selbst presents native intercourse as restricted to itself, continuing the reflexive chain from g:s5 and g:s6. English substitutes the continent as the reflexive referent, weakens einheimischen native to local, and collapses Verkehr into the same contact used for Berührung in g:s5. A contextually understandable gloss, but it adds a geographic referent and scope.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text

evidence.statement: Fremdes is an indefinite singular substantivised adjective, whatever foreign matter or anything foreign, matched by singular hat in the main clause. Plural elements concretises it into discrete components and can suggest specifically linguistic elements, which the German does not specify.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: differences unmistakable in the languages themselves as well
evidence.statement: German has only the pronoun 'ihnen'; its antecedent can be 'sie' (the languages, subject of 'welchen sie angehören') or 'Nationen'. The English substitutes an explicit noun, so it settles the question in the text itself. The languages reading is defensible and probably the stronger one: 'auch ... selbst' marks a shift to a different entity from the one whose 'Ausbildung' is at issue, and a nations reading ('differences in the nations' Ausbildung, unmistakable in the nations themselves') is close to tautological. That is an argument from sense, not a grammatical proof, and the packet asks for interpretations to go in separate notes.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: places them all
evidence.statement: Bare 'alle' may be 'alle Nationen' (the clause concerns 'Ausbildung' and 'Stufe') or 'alle Sprachen' (the paragraph's topic). 'Them all' is itself a suitably open pronoun, but because F1's explicit 'the languages themselves' now sits immediately before it, an English reader will most likely take 'them' as the languages. The German does not force that, and it changes what is ranked lower: the languages or the nations' cultivation. The printed parallel ('Alle sind ferner in dem Mangel alphabetischer Schrift ... einander gleich') shows a languages reading is possible for Humboldt, but the packet bars using it to decide the base text.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: do not permit genuinely separating boundaries to be drawn even in this respect
evidence.statement: The English puts the focus of 'nicht einmal' on 'darin' ('not even in this respect'). The adjacency 'nicht einmal darin' supports that, so the rendering is defensible. Two things stay open: what 'darin' refers to (the 'Züge der Aehnlichkeit', or structure generally), and whether the intended force is instead 'do not even permit truly dividing boundaries to be drawn in this', with the north/south division as the thing that fails. 'In this respect' is a suitably neutral rendering of 'darin'.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: all the languages of America do exhibit broad features of similarity
evidence.statement: 'wirklich' is carried only by emphatic 'do'. In the German it answers 'fälschlich behauptete' (wrongly asserted sameness against really present similarity), and that contrast is fainter in the English. This is a weakening, not a meaning error.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: as does their deviation from the structure of all other languages, which has also sometimes been asserted
evidence.statement: The second 'sometimes' has no direct counterpart in this clause: German has 'auch wohl behauptete', not a repetition of 'bisweilen'. The English therefore imports the frequency of the first claim into the second and leaves the force of 'wohl' unrepresented. 'fälschlich' is correctly confined to the asserted sameness and is not extended to the deviation.

evidence.claim_status: model_judgment_on_pre_revision_text
evidence.excerpt: the north and south of the continent do not permit genuinely separating boundaries to be drawn even in this respect
evidence.statement: German uses singular 'erlaubt' with 'der Norden und Süden des Welttheils', presenting north and south collectively as one part of the world. English plural 'do not permit' is idiomatic but presents them more as two separate subjects, slightly weakening that collective presentation. Placing 'even in this respect' at the end nevertheless preserves the sense of 'nicht einmal darin'.
